svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given the CI chooser at `spec/_ci.json`; beat 1: the board is built → every home card whose screen is in the gate wears a CI mark, and the guide names the chooser by file; beat 2: the chooser changes, or is deleted → the marks follow it — an absent chooser means every screen, exactly as the gate resolves it
